北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天有霾，体感 -3℃，记得戴口罩，多保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy, feels like -3℃. Remember to wear a mask and keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，湿度大，体感 6℃。出门别忘带伞，注意防潮！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, high humidity, feels like 6℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海今天下雨，体感 1℃，湿冷。注意添衣，别着凉了！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is rainy, feels like 1℃. It's damp and cold, dress warmly!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，19℃ 左右，体感舒适。注意早晚温差哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, around 19℃. It feels pleasant, mind the temperature changes!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，19℃ 左右，体感温暖。出门记得带外套呀。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, around 19℃. It's warm, bring a jacket when going out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，体感 4℃，湿冷。出门带伞，添衣保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has moderate rain, feels like 4℃. Damp and cold, grab your umbrella and layer up!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，体感 -3℃。路滑，慢行注意安全哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and feels like -3℃. Roads might be slippery, drive carefully!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 8℃。注意早晚温差，小心着凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 8℃. Watch out for temperature drops, don't catch a cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨，体感 -2℃，湿冷。多穿点，别感冒了！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain, feels like -2℃. It's damp and cold, dress warm to avoid catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 0℃。注意保暖，出门多穿几层哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 0℃. Keep warm, wear extra layers when you go out!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阵雨，体感 7℃，湿度大。带好雨具，注意路滑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has showers, feels like 7℃. Bring rain gear, and watch for slippery roads!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 -20℃！超级冷，全副武装出门哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels like -20℃! Extremely cold, bundle up completely when going out!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 -16℃，风有点凉。多穿厚衣物！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -16℃, with a cool breeze. Wear thick clothes!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 15℃，阳光正好。防晒也别忘咯！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 15℃. The sun is out, don't forget sun protection!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，19℃ 左右，体感温暖。早晚添衣哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, around 19℃. It feels warm, add layers in the morning and evening!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -3℃。风力不小，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -3℃. It's quite windy, keep warm and protect from wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -12℃，风力大。防风保暖，多穿点！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -12℃, with strong wind. Protect from wind and keep very warm!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
